s-1.ptxt: Remove V-bank Cover Sub-assembly

s2.ptxt: Place both hands on the front of the cover and lift it upward to disengage the 2 front clips, then continue lifting upward to disengage the 1 rear clips, and remove the V-bank cover.

atten3.ptxt: Pulling up the front and rear at the same time may cause damage.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Crankshaft Position Sensor NO.2 (Bank 1 Intake Side)

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector from crank position sensor No.2.
Remove the bolt and remove crank position sensor No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Crankshaft Position Sensor NO.2 (Bank 2 Intake Side)

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector from crank position sensor No.2.
Remove the bolt and remove crank position sensor No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Crankshaft Position Sensor NO.2 (Bank 2 Exhaust Side)

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector from crank position sensor No.2.
Remove the bolt and remove crank position sensor No.2.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Wiper Arm Head Cap

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 front wiper arm head caps.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Wiper Arm & Blade Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the front wiper arm nut and front wiper arm & blade assembly RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Wiper Arm & Blade Assembly LH

s2.ptxt: Remove the front wiper arm nut and front wiper arm & blade assembly LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Hood to Cowl Top Seal

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 7 clips and remove the hood to cowl top seal.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Side Panel Protector NO.1 LH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the pin and remove front side panel protector NO.1 LH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Cowl Top Ventilator Louver LH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 11 claws and remove the cowl top ventilator louver LH as shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Side Panel Protector NO.1 RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the pin and remove front side panel protector NO.1 RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Cowl Top Ventilator Louver RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 5 claws and remove the cowl top ventilator louver RH as shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Windshield Wiper Motor & Link Assembly

s2.ptxt: Remove the 2 bolts and disconnect the windshield wiper motor & link assembly.
Disconnect the connector and clamp, and remove the windshield wiper motor & link assembly as shown in the illustration.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Cowl Body Mounting Reinforcement RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the 3 bolts and remove the cowl body mounting reinforcement RH from the cowl top panel outer.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Cowl Top Panel Outer

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the windshield deicer wire harness connector and disengage the 3 clamps, and detach them from the cowl top panel outer. (w/ Cold Area Specification)
Disengage the clamps of the heater air duct splash shield seal No.2 and water guard plate RH, and bend each as shown in the illustration.
Remove the 8 bolts and the cowl top panel outer.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Radiator Upper Air Deflector

s2.ptxt: Remove the 9 clips and the radiator upper air deflector.

s-1.ptxt: Drain Coolant (Toyota Genuine Super Long Life Coolant)

atten2.ptxt: To avoid the danger of being burned, do not remove the reservoir tank cap while the engine and radiator are still hot. Liquid and steam will spray out under pressure.

s2.ptxt: Loosen the radiator drain cock plug.
Remove the reserve tank cap and drain the coolant.
Loosen the cylinder block drain cock plug and drain the coolant from the engine.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Air Cleaner Cap w/ Air Cleaner Hose

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the air flow meter connector. (*1).
Disconnect ventilation hose No.2. (*2).
Disconnect the hose band (*3)
Disengage the 3 clamps and remove the air cleaner cap w/ air cleaner hose.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Intake Air Surge Tank Assembly

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the vacuum hose from the throttle body assembly. (*1)
Slide the 2 clips and disconnect the water bypass hose No.2 and water bypass hose No.3 from the throttle body assembly (*2).
Disconnect the throttle motor connector from the throttle body assembly (*3).
Disconnect the air control valve connector from the intake air surge tank.
Remove the 2 bolts and surge tank stay No.1.
Remove the 2 bolts and the throttle body bracket.
Remove the 2 nuts from the intake air surge tank. (*1)
Using a socket hexagon wrench (5mm), remove the 4 bolts. (*2)
Remove the intake air surge tank and gasket.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Crankshaft Position Sensor NO.2 (Bank 1 Exhaust Side)

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector from crank position sensor No.2.
Remove the bolt and remove crank position sensor No.2.
